summary: Rabbi Soffer reviews the seven criteria required to speak about another person in a way that is permissible according to Hilchot Lashon HaRa. He concludes the first part of the book and introduces the definition of Rechilut, explaining the prohibition against passing along information between people.
subjects: Story of Doeg HaEdumi and Nov Ir HaKoanim
questions: What are the seven criteria required to speak about someone else?
Can I tell someone what another person said about them?
What should I do if someone accuses me of something I did not do?
Is it permissible to pass along information if it is true?
What is the difference between Lashon HaRa and Rechilut?
